headline: Pakistan Gold Prices Reach Record Rs378,636 Per Tola Following Global Gains
summary: Local gold prices in Pakistan increased by Rs4,700 to reach Rs378,636 per tola in line with gains in international markets.
why: Precious metal prices in domestic markets track international bullion rates adjusted for local currency values.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Rise in global gold futures directly feeds into domestic retail and wholesale bullion pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
